description: The installation of a 20 metre high monopole supporting six antenna apertures and four 600mm dishes, the installation of eight equipment cabinets at ground level within a fenced compound with associated development ancillary thereto
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The apparatus hereby permitted shall be removed from the land on which it is situated as soon as reasonably practicable after it is no longer required for electronic communications purposes.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until detailed design, method statements and load calculations (in consultation with London Underground), have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which: Provide details on foundations, drawings and construction methodologies (RAMS), details  the use of tall plant for the installation of the monopole and accommodate the location of the existing London Underground structures and the operational railway with appropriate risk assessments and safety measures to be approved by LU Engineer. 

The development shall thereafter be carried out in all respects in accordance with the approved design and method statements, and all structures and works comprised within the development hereby permitted which are required by the approved design statements in order to procure the matters mentioned in paragraphs of this condition shall be completed, in their entirety, before any part of the building hereby permitted is occupied.
